# Bibliography style provenance

`../../plainurl.bst` is an unmodified file from the official CTAN `urlbst`
0.9.1 distribution, obtained 2026-11-06 from
https://mirrors.ctan.org/biblio/bibtex/contrib/urlbst.zip .
Its SHA-256 is `3fed7ca6a2db55121e4856952f5d89655500e47e8a35af18a88f63752812f183`.

The original header and copyright notices are preserved. The original plain
style permits redistribution under its header terms; Norman Gray's urlbst
modifications are under the LPPL. `README.upstream` and `LICENCE-lppl.txt`
are the unmodified accompanying upstream files. This third-party style is
not covered by this project's 0BSD/CC0 declarations. The complete unmodified upstream ZIP is also included for source and license
provenance. Its GPL-licensed generation script is not executed by this build.

The local copy avoids a required Tectonic network fetch during BibTeX and
preserves URL and DOI output. It is part of the paper's build-source hashes.

Complete upstream ZIP SHA-256: `c896493c646dc8ce7a4d20866fe87ae73284e69f2c56e6f02b330d8206748fd1`.
